description: We are a team bridging low-level embedded hardware and responsive web interfaces to tackle astronaut health autonomy. We are building an offline, zero-touch bio-telemetry system that pairs edge wearable sensors with an interactive clinical dashboard for deep-space missions. Our core skills span C/C++ firmware, Bluetooth LE protocol engineering, and modern web UI. Looking for collaborators with interests in UI/UX design, space biology/medicine, or technical storytelling. Join us!
